raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "1.16.0" %}

package:
  name: python3-saml
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/python3-saml/python3-saml-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 97c9669aecabc283c6e5fb4eb264f446b6e006f5267d01c9734f9d8bffdac133

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - poetry >=1.1.15
    - setuptools >=40.1.0
    - wheel
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - isodate >=0.6.1
    - xmlsec >=1.3.9
    - lxml >=4.6.5,!=4.7.0

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - onelogin
    - onelogin.saml2

about:
  home: https://github.com/onelogin/python3-saml
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Onelogin Python Toolkit. Add SAML support to your Python software using this library

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - xylar
    - jaimergp
